v1_pilot.source: Mongo books: projected public metadata only
v1_pilot.normalization: NFKC, case-fold, whitespace; split only pipe delimiters. Names are metadata strings, not resolved human identities.
v1_pilot.scoring: Weighted cosine over shared typed features. weight=(2 for author else 1)*(1+ln((N+1)/(degree+1))). No embeddings, LLM, behavioral or availability score.
v1_pilot.scope: systematic pilot, every 50th catalogue book_id plus frozen 40 seeds

initial_v2_pilot.source: Mongo books: projected public metadata only
initial_v2_pilot.normalization: NFKC, case-fold, whitespace; split only pipe delimiters. Names are metadata strings, not resolved human identities.
initial_v2_pilot.scoring: Weighted cosine using explicit relation weights and retained graph degree. Topic amplitude 0.5 gives one quarter of subject squared weight at equal degree; conservative untuned initial policy.
initial_v2_pilot.scope: systematic pilot, every 50th catalogue book_id plus frozen 40 seeds

topic_policy.language_policy: Unicode source phrases; English stop words plus conservative generic terms. Language unknown, never inferred.

initial_v2_pilot.weak_feature_qualification: Only author, subject and bounded description-topic connections qualify. Publisher/language/era unavailable and never qualify alone.

refined_v2_pilot.source: Mongo books: projected public metadata only
refined_v2_pilot.normalization: NFKC, case-fold, whitespace; split only pipe delimiters. Names are metadata strings, not resolved human identities.
refined_v2_pilot.scoring: Weighted cosine using explicit relation weights and retained graph degree. Topic amplitude 0.5 gives one quarter of subject squared weight at equal degree; conservative untuned initial policy.
refined_v2_pilot.scope: systematic 100040-book pilot; global V1 subject vocabulary

topic_policy.language_policy: Unicode source phrases; English stop words plus conservative generic terms. Language unknown, never inferred.

refined_v2_pilot.weak_feature_qualification: Only author, subject and bounded description-topic connections qualify. Publisher/language/era unavailable and never qualify alone.
refined_v2_pilot.topic_vocabulary: Exact normalized phrases already present as subject labels in frozen full V1 graph; no title inference, generative labels or per-seed allowlist.

frozen_population: 100040 systematic pilot works including all 40 frozen KG3 seeds; V1 and V2 have the same books. This is NOT full-5M V1 versus a small V2.
published_pilot_quick_check: ok for V1, initial V2 and refined V2

full_build_gate.decision: STOP AT PILOT; preserve production V1

full_projection.limitation: Linear projections from 100K; corpus degree, vocabulary growth and indexing can scale nonlinearly. Preserve V1 and allow 3x V2 output for staging/compaction.

note: Earlier failed staging artifact retained separately; it is not a published graph.
